Small rules, big difference

Color is a relationship.

01

Hue is the family.

Red, blue, and everything in between. Hue is where a color lives on the wheel.

02

Saturation is the voice.

Turn it up for a vivid shout. Turn it down for a quiet, dusty conversation.

03

Lightness is the space.

Lightness sets the atmosphere — from deep shadow to sunlit color.
